{{Quote|Even though I'm a Jedi, I am not invincible. There are many in the galaxy who can defeat me. Now I understand why we were taught over and over that our motive must be sure, our concentration total. I underestimated the dark side of the Force. I will try not to do so again. And I know now that I will not always be strong. I will not be afraid to recognize when I am weak.|Siri Tachi, to [[Obi-Wan Kenobi/Legends|Obi-Wan Kenobi]]|<ref name="The Dangerous Rescue">''[[Jedi Apprentice: The Dangerous Rescue]]''</ref>}}
'''Siri Tachi''' was a [[Gender/Legends|female]] [[Human/Legends|Human]] [[Jedi Master/Legends|Jedi Master]], [[Padawan/Legends|apprentice]] of [[Adi Gallia/Legends|Adi Gallia]] and [[Master]] to [[Ferus Olin]]. She was a talented [[Pilot/Legends|pilot]] who participated in the [[First Battle of Geonosis/Legends|First Battle of Geonosis]], fighting alongside Master Gallia guarding the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]] transports in space above the planet.

She was one of [[Obi-Wan Kenobi/Legends|Obi-Wan Kenobi's]] closest friends, and at one point they were romantically involved. During the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]], she met an early death on [[Azure/Legends|Azure]] while on a mission with Kenobi.

==Biography==
===Padawan===
{{Quote|If the order were made up only of those invulnerable to love, it would be a sad group altogether.''"<br />"''Does that mean there is a woman to be discovered in even Master Obi-Wan's past?|Obi-Wan Kenobi and Anakin Skywalker|<ref name="Yoda: Dark Rendezvous">''[[Yoda: Dark Rendezvous]]''</ref>}}
[[File:SiriTachi-JA9.jpg|thumb|left|200px|Siri Tachi as a new [[Padawan/Legends|Padawan]] learner, with her [[Lightsaber/Legends#Blade colors|violet lightsaber]].]]
Though two [[Standard year/Legends|years]] younger than [[Obi-Wan Kenobi/Legends|Obi-Wan Kenobi]], Tachi was just as powerful in her skills with a [[Lightsaber/Legends|lightsaber]] and [[The Force/Legends|the Force]]. As a preteen, she had a very tomboyish attitude, even while considered attractive by her male peers. As with Kenobi, Tachi had a rivalry with fellow [[Jedi/Legends|Jedi]] trainee [[Bruck Chun]].<ref name="The Captive Temple" />

The first time Tachi spoke to Kenobi, she had already learned of his temporary leave from the [[Jedi Order/Legends|Jedi Order]] to help the adolescents on [[Melida/Daan/Legends|Melida/Daan]] to halt the [[Melida/Daan Civil War|civil war]] on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]], and was angry with him, calling him an embarrassment to all potential [[Padawan/Legends|Padawans]] (this was before she was chosen as a Padawan herself). Later on, however, she helped him trace Bruck Chun's connection in [[Xanatos]]' [[Incident at the Jedi Temple|infiltration]] of the [[Jedi Temple/Legends|Jedi Temple]].<ref name="The Captive Temple" />

A few months following the Xanatos incident, [[Jedi Master/Legends|Jedi Master]] [[Adi Gallia/Legends|Adi Gallia]] chose Tachi to be her Padawan learner. The two accompanied Kenobi and his Master [[Qui-Gon Jinn/Legends|Qui-Gon Jinn]] on several missions to planets such as [[Kegan/Legends|Kegan]],<ref name="The Fight for Truth" /> [[Simpla-12]], and [[Sorrus]]. With Adi Gallia, Tachi helped Kenobi rescue Jinn from the Force-obsessed [[Scientist/Legends|scientist]] [[Jenna Zan Arbor]]. Later, Kenobi saved her from the [[Bounty hunter/Legends|bounty hunter]] [[Ona Nobis]]. Before this mission, Tachi was a headstrong and impatient Padawan, having difficulty understanding when to refrain from a fight, but learning from Kenobi's example, she became more patient and prudent.<ref name="The Dangerous Rescue" />

[[File:SiriTachi-SOTJ.jpg|thumb|180px|Tachi during her later [[Padawan/Legends|Padawan]] years.]]
It was not until a few years into their friendship that Tachi and Kenobi discovered their new feelings for each other. Along with their Masters, the two were again sent on a mission together: this time to save a boy, [[Talesan Fry]], from bounty hunters on the planet [[Cirrus]]. After crashing on the planet [[Quadrant Seven]], the Masters sent the Padawans to hide in the nearby caves in order to protect Fry. During the time they spent in the caves, Tachi and Kenobi's bickering briefly allowed them to express their feelings for each other, but they decided to put their focus on the mission. At one point in the mission, the Padawans and Fry were on board a ship rigged to blow up if it exited [[Hyperspace/Legends|hyperspace]].<ref name="Secrets of the Jedi" />

It was during this time of potential death that Tachi and Kenobi truly recognized their feelings, and after finding a way to land the ship safely, they confirmed that they were in love. They agreed to discuss their situation more in depth after the mission was over. After putting Fry into safe hands (following the death of his parents at the hands of the bounty hunter [[Magus (bounty hunter)|Magus]]), the two agreed to abandon their love, after a talk with Jinn and [[Yoda/Legends|Yoda]] about the consequences of Jinn's love for the late Jedi Master [[Tahl]]. Tachi and Kenobi vowed never to speak of their love again. However, this decision led to the gradual drifting of their friendship.<ref name="Secrets of the Jedi" />

===Undercover===
{{Quote|So you are a Jedi. What did [Anakin Skywalker] call you? Siri?"<br />"No more. I left them long ago but they have this ridiculous code of loyalty. They think they own me. No one owns me!"<br />"Ah you forget something. I do."<br />"''No one'' owns me, Krayn.|Krayn and Tachi, after the latter's true identity was compromised|<ref name="Jedi Quest: The Path to Truth">''[[Jedi Quest: Path to Truth]]''</ref>}}
[[File:Undercoversiri.jpg|thumb|left|190px|"Zora," Tachi's disguise while infiltrating Krayn's organization.]]
Shortly after the [[Invasion of Naboo/Legends|Invasion of Naboo]], Tachi and Adi Gallia had a major disagreement, which led to Gallia dismissing her informally as Padawan, and Tachi leaving the Jedi Order. She joined the [[Slavery/Legends|slave trader]] [[Krayn]] and renamed herself Zora. Tachi remained a part of his operations as his right-hand person when she briefly encountered Kenobi and his new apprentice, [[Anakin Skywalker/Legends|Anakin Skywalker]]. Kenobi, like most other Jedi, had believed that Tachi was a traitor.<ref name="Jedi Quest: The Path to Truth" />

However, after the encounter with Zora and lashing out at her, he later searched his feelings and realized the truth that Tachi would never actually betray the Jedi. This was confirmed by the [[Jedi High Council/Legends|Jedi High Council]], revealing that Tachi's "disagreement" with Adi Gallia and her "dismissal" from the Jedi Order were all part of an intricate plan set up by the Council to overthrow Krayn's slave operations. Soon after this revelation, Skywalker, who was captured earlier and made a slave, inadvertently disclosed the true identity of "Zora", and Krayn imprisoned her with Skywalker. Working together, the two Jedi convinced the slaves to organize a revolt. With Kenobi's help from the outside, they succeeded in destroying Krayn's operations, ending with Skywalker killing the slaver. Her undercover mission finished, Tachi was welcomed back to the Jedi Order.<ref name="Jedi Quest: The Path to Truth" /> In [[28 BBY/Legends|28 BBY]], Tachi recorded a statement to the Jedi Council defending Skywalker's actions, reminding the Council that they had sanctioned Kenobi and Skywalker's mission and their encounter had been no accident. Tachi noted that Skywalker acted with impatience during his first mission, but that more than anyone he was responsible for liberating the slaves on [[Nar Shaddaa/Legends|Nar Shaddaa]]. She also pondered if Skywalker had been motivated by revenge to kill Krayn, then attested that had she been in Skywalker's position, Krayn would have died by her lightsaber. With that, she was of the belief that Krayn's death was decided not by Skywalker, but by the will of the Force.<ref name="Jedi vs. Sith: The Essential Guide to the Force">[[Jedi vs. Sith: The Essential Guide to the Force (real-life book)|''Jedi vs. Sith: The Essential Guide to the Force'']]</ref>

===Jedi Knight===
{{Quote|You look relieved. I am, too."<br />"You didn't seem very worried."<br />"When do I ever seem worried? I just hide things better than you do, that's all. Sometimes I wonder if you expect me to have any feelings at all, Obi-Wan....|Obi-Wan Kenobi exudes concern for his Padawan, admiring Siri Tachi's seeming "cool confidence" in her own|<ref name="The Way of the Apprentice" />}}
[[File:Decommissioning_Trevas.jpg|thumb|right|230px|Siri Tachi alongside Kenobi and Skywalker confronting assassin droids in the [[Grand Convocation Chamber|Senate Chamber]].]]
Upon her return from Nar Shaddaa, Tachi became a [[Jedi Knight/Legends|Jedi Knight]], and she took [[Ferus Olin]] as her Padawan learner. They went on a number of missions together, along with Kenobi and Skywalker, to places such as [[Radnor/Legends|Radnor]]<ref name="The Way of the Apprentice" /> and [[Euceron]].<ref name="The Dangerous Games">''[[Jedi Quest: The Dangerous Games]]''</ref> One mission was when Tachi and Kenobi's apprentices infiltrated and posed as students at the [[Leadership School]] on [[Andara/Legends|Andara]] in order to discover the background behind the kidnapped son of a [[Senator/Legends|Senator]]. Tachi and Kenobi's part of the mission involved them posing as the [[King/Legends|king]] and [[Queen/Legends|queen]] of [[Cortella]] considering the enrollment of their "children" at the school.<ref name="The School of Fear">''[[Jedi Quest: The School of Fear]]''</ref>

Other missions that Tachi and Olin took included their rescue of Kenobi and Skywalker from Jenna Zan Arbor on [[Vanqor/Legends|Vanqor]],<ref name="The Moment of Truth">''[[Jedi Quest: The Moment of Truth]]''</ref> their investigation of Zan Arbor, [[Roy Teda]], and [[Granta Omega]] on [[Romin]],<ref name="The Changing of the Guard">''[[Jedi Quest: The Changing of the Guard]]''</ref> and their investigation of Zan Arbor's [[Blackwater Systems]] laboratory on [[Falleen (planet)/Legends|Falleen]], before a crucial mission on [[Coruscant/Legends|Coruscant]].<ref name="The False Peace">''[[Jedi Quest: The False Peace]]''</ref>

Following Omega, Zan Arbor, and Teda to the [[Capital/Legends|capital]] world, Tachi, Olin, Kenobi, and Skywalker discovered their plans to assassinate hundreds of [[Senator/Legends|Senators]] and dignitaries, including [[Supreme Chancellor/Legends|Supreme Chancellor]] [[Palpatine/Legends|Palpatine]] himself, using [[Assassin droid/Legends|assassin droids]] assigned to specific targets. Tachi, Kenobi and Skywalker went off to find the trio of criminals while Olin valiantly protected the Chancellor and Senators from the droids (though there were some two dozen casualties).<ref name="The False Peace" /> Following the death of Teda and another escape by Omega and Zan Arbor, the two master and apprentice pairs headed for [[Korriban/Legends|Korriban]], where the two criminals were reported to have been seen.<ref name="The Final Showdown">''[[Jedi Quest: The Final Showdown]]''</ref>

Along with [[Soara Antana/Legends|Soara Antana]], [[Ry-Gaul]], and their respective apprentices, [[Darra Thel-Tanis]] and [[Tru Veld]], the investigation of the Jedi in Korriban's capital of [[Dreshdae]] led them to Omega and Zan Arbor in the [[Valley of the Dark Lords/Legends|Valley of the Dark Lords]]. It was during this fateful mission that Thel-Tanis was killed by Omega. After completing the mission (which resulted in Omega's death and Zan Arbor's escape) and returning to the Temple, Olin expressed his guilt over Thel-Tanis' death and announced that he was resigning from the Jedi Order.<ref name="The Final Showdown" />

===Clone Wars===
====Early months====
{{Quote|Siri, do you have the target?"<br />"Yes, Master, it's some kind of power plant. Readings show that it fuels all the droid foundries in the vicinity."<br />"Then destroying it will be a major victory for the Republic.|Gallia and Tachi, during the [[First Battle of Geonosis/Legends|First Battle of Geonosis]]|<ref name="Jedi Starfighter" />}}
[[File:SiriTachi.jpg|thumb|left|180px|Tachi during the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]]]]
After Olin's resignation, Tachi never took another Padawan. By the time she became a Jedi Master,<ref name="The Last of the Jedi: Secret Weapon">''[[The Last of the Jedi: Secret Weapon]]''</ref> she mostly worked on solo missions and befriended the [[Pilot/Legends|pilot]] [[Nym/Legends|Nym]] and his squadron, the [[Lok Revenants/Legends|Lok Revenants]]. Tachi helped them defeat the [[Trade Federation/Legends|Trade Federation]] numerous times, until eventually she parted ways with them. However, Tachi fought alongside them again, with Adi Gallia and a number of other Jedi pilots, using the new [[Delta-7 Aethersprite-class light interceptor/Legends|Delta-7 ''Aethersprite'']] [[Starfighter/Legends|starfighters]]. She was introduced to the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic's]] new [[Grand Army of the Republic/Legends|Clone Army]] and guarded the Republic transports with Gallia in space above [[Geonosis/Legends|Geonosis]], where Kenobi, Skywalker, and Senator [[Padmé Amidala/Legends|Padmé Amidala]] were being held by [[Count/Legends|Count]] [[Dooku/Legends|Dooku's]] [[Confederacy of Independent Systems/Legends|Confederacy of Independent Systems]]. Without her and her former Master protecting the Republic transports, all of the remaining Jedi fighting in the arena would have been destroyed by Dooku's droid army. Prior to the [[First Battle of Geonosis/Legends|First Battle of Geonosis]], Tachi aided her former Master Adi Gallia in thwarting [[Cavik Toth]]'s fleet of [[Hex Deployer]]s. This was the start of the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]].<ref name="Jedi Starfighter" />

Following the Battle of Geonosis, Tachi went to [[Kamino/Legends|Kamino]] to investigate the sighting of [[Slave I/Legends|''Slave I'']], despite its owner [[Jango Fett/Legends|Jango Fett]] having been killed by [[Mace Windu/Legends|Mace Windu]] early in the battle. While on Kamino, Tachi almost discovered Fett's son, [[Boba Fett/Legends|Boba]], but having been forewarned that a Jedi was arriving, he managed to elude her.<ref name="The Fight to Survive">''[[Boba Fett: The Fight to Survive]]''</ref>

===Final mission and death===
Eventually, Tachi reunited with Kenobi and Skywalker, as well as Padmé Amidala, to go to the planet [[Genian]]. The Separatists were after an important codebreaking mechanism invented by Talesan Fry, whom Tachi and Kenobi had met decades earlier. Fry was now the founder of a very wealthy business on Genian, a world that remained neutral during the war. Reuniting with Fry brought back old memories to Kenobi and Tachi of the feeling of love that they once had for each other. After convincing Fry to give the device to the Republic, they were attacked by someone else from the past, the bounty hunter Magus, who had killed Fry's parents.<ref name="Secrets of the Jedi" />

Fry accompanied the Jedi and Senator Amidala to [[Azure/Legends|Azure]], where the Republic was fighting off more Separatists. While Kenobi, Skywalker, and Fry fought off the attack led by Magus (who was working for the [[Corporate Alliance/Legends|Corporate Alliance]]), Tachi and Amidala took a starfighter of their own to go after Magus himself. Upon reaching Magus, Tachi made a desperate leap and landed on his starfighter, leaving Amidala to fly the ship herself. Tachi was able to break into Magus' ship and fight him off, which resulted in the ship's crash landing.<ref name="Secrets of the Jedi" />

When the other Jedi found them, Fry already had Magus held at gunpoint while Tachi was fatally injured, having been shot by Magus. Kenobi tried to save her but she stopped him, knowing she was dying. Obi-Wan and Siri Tachi expressed their love for each other once more and she handed him the blue warming crystal she had from their first mission, telling Obi-Wan that she would always be with him and then finally passed on.

Like his master before him, Obi-Wan came close to the [[Dark side of the Force/Legends|dark side]] with the loss of the woman he loved, as he held his lightsaber blade to Magus' throat. However, like Qui-Gon, he regained control before it was too late, sparing the bounty hunter. Later, Skywalker wondered about Kenobi's feelings for Tachi, but incorrectly came to the conclusion that his Master did not love Tachi because he did not kill her murderer. Kenobi had learned to love with an open heart, and could live with losing Tachi.

===Legacy===
The memory of a dedicated Jedi and dear friend lived on with Kenobi<ref name="Secrets of the Jedi" /> and he continued to miss her just as constantly and intently as he went into exile to watch over young [[Luke Skywalker/Legends|Luke Skywalker]] on [[Tatooine/Legends|Tatooine]] following the [[Great Jedi Purge/Legends|Great Jedi Purge]].<ref name="The Last of the Jedi: The Desperate Mission">''[[The Last of the Jedi: The Desperate Mission]]''</ref>

==Personality and traits==
[[File:Siri_Tachi.jpg|150px|left|Siri Tachi.]]
{{Quote|I never lose my focus, Obi-Wan. Or my commitment.|Siri Tachi to Obi-Wan Kenobi|<ref name="The Fight for Truth" />}}
Siri Tachi was usually very determined and focused. As an apprentice, her strong determination often made it difficult for her to avoid combat when given the choice.<ref name="DB" /> Her focus and self-belief also made it difficult for her to work well with others, often as she considered herself strong enough to complete things on her own.<ref name="The Fight for Truth" /> But with Obi-Wan's example, Tachi became more patient and prudent.<ref name="The Dangerous Rescue" /> She was loyal to the Jedi Order and until after the mission to Kegan, she held Obi-Wan Kenobi's decision to temporarily leave the Order against him.<ref name="The Fight for Truth" /> This loyalty later allowed Kenobi to come to the conclusion that Tachi had not left the Jedi Order.<ref name="Jedi Quest: The Path to Truth" />

==Powers and abilities==
{{Quote|Siri has an extraordinary sensitivity to the Force. She's gotten us out of quite a few tight spots."<br />"Well, I might sense the danger, but Master Adi gets us out of it."|[[Adi Gallia/Legends|Adi Gallia]] compliments her Padawan's [[Force power/Legends|Force powers]]|<ref name="Secrets of the Jedi" />}}
Although Tachi was two years younger than Obi-Wan, her lightsaber skills were excellent.<ref name="The Captive Temple" /><ref name="The Fight for Truth" /> She was highly focused in her duels, never letting emotions cloud her. Her lightsaber style may have been [[Form IV/Legends|Ataru]], which was heavily based on athletics. Even Bruck Chun could not match her.<ref name="The Captive Temple" />

Tachi was extremely good at using the Force to detect others,<ref name="Secrets of the Jedi" /> and could apply a variety of [[Telekinesis/Legends|telekinetic skills]], such as shoves, lifting and throwing objects.<ref name="The Changing of the Guard" />

==Behind the scenes==
Siri Tachi was created by author [[Jude Watson]].

[[Corie Henninger]] voiced Tachi in the ''[[Star Wars: Jedi Starfighter]]'' video game.
